title: R&D Insights and Operations - Growth
description:
About Gusto

At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff - payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR - so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) - because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy .

AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

About the Role:

We're looking for a builder to help construct a world class Growth organization. This is an opinionated leader that is motivated by creating big picture vision and digging into where the biggest opportunities are, sizing them, and building the systems, rigor, and connective tissue that let Growth and GTM operate cohesively. This is a member of Gusto's Insights & Operations (I&O) team - our internal Strategy/BizOps function - embedded against Growth, partnering closely with our Head of Growth and our CRO-side GTM leadership.

This role is intentionally IC-first. You'll start by going deep on the highest-leverage problems in Growth, build a point of view grounded in data, and drive it to outcome. As trust and scope grow, this role is expected to expand - most likely into owning the operating bridge between Growth and our broader go-to-market organization, and potentially into building and leading a small team.

About the Team:

Gusto's Growth organization is on an ambitious trajectory: we're building toward a much more self-serve-led motion, and the opportunity ahead is significant. As Growth scales, we have a chance to be much more intentional about how it connects to Product and to our go-to-market teams (sales, demand gen, expansion sales, pricing, etc) - building a shared, prioritized roadmap and clear visibility into dependencies from the ground up, rather than retrofitting it later.

Here’s what you’ll do day-to-day:

• Identify and size the highest-leverage opportunities for Growth: go from a fuzzy problem to a clear-eyed analysis of the opportunity, a recommendation on whether to pursue it, and a plan if the answer is yes.

• Anchor on problems, not headcount: dig into what's actually slowing the Growth organization down, define how to build a best in class engine, size the opportunity, and decide what's worth solving before proposing who or what is needed - not the reverse.

• Build the operating rhythm for Growth and drive execution against it: planning cycles, prioritization, and a shared, prioritized roadmap that makes trade-offs and dependencies visible across Growth R&D, Product R&D, and GTM.

• Bring real analytical rigor to how Growth invests - attribution, LTV, and testing/experimentation discipline - so decisions about where to deploy resources are tied clearly to business impact.

• Close the gap between Growth R&D and go-to-market: build the mechanisms (shared roadmap, dependency tracking, decision forums) that let both orgs operate as one team working toward the same number, rather than two orgs trading requests.

• Design an operating system anchored in technology vs. humans: build the muscle and mechanisms the Growth org can through automation, and hand off ownership once a system is running

• Act as a trusted advisor to Growth leadership: pressure-test strategy, surface risks and blind spots early, and bring an opinionated point of view, not just facilitation.

• Use AI as a default, not an add-on: build reusable, AI-powered workflows for planning, synthesi

title: Director of Client Advisory
description:
Sandline Global is a premier litigation support and eDiscovery service provider, helping global legal teams escape the ups and downs of the eDiscovery quality rollercoaster.
The Sandline Director of Client Advisory will be responsible for client outreach, building relationships, uncovering client pain points, and educating law firm and corporate prospects on Sandline Global ’s end-to-end eDiscovery services and differentiators. A successful candidate will have excellent communication skills, a commitment to continued growth and improvement, a caring and empathetic approach to solving client challenges, and a friendly and team-oriented attitude. Candidates must have a passion for consultative selling and helping clients find a state of optimal agility. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of achieving sales targets and building customer relationships and 3-6 years in eDiscovery or legal technology sales.
Responsibilities:

• Research, prospect, and generate new business leads

• Draw on existing relationships and book of business.

• Build and maintain relationships with customers to ensure repeat business.

• Demonstrate in-depth knowledge of our products and services.

• Participate in promotional events and campaigns to increase sales.

• Collaborate with the rest of the sales team to meet overall company goals.

Requirements:

• Proven work experience in eDiscovery or legal services sales or a related field.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

• Ability to work in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong consultative approach to identifying pain points and solving client challenges.

• Self-motivated with a results-driven approach.

• Ability to work a flexible schedule, including evenings and weekends.

• Basic computer skills and familiarity with various CRMs.

Education and Qualifications:

• Bachelors degree or equivalent preferred.

• Prior education in sales or marketing is preferred but not required.

• Ideally 3-6 years of eDiscovery sales or relevant legal services sales experience.

Salary: $110,000 - 125,000 based on experience
Benefits:

• Employer-funded healthcare program including medical, vision, and dental

• Employer-funded $50k life insurance and AD&D coverage

• Additional voluntary life insurance and AD&D coverage available at low premiums

• Employer-funded Short-term and Long-term disability coverage

• 401K matching

• Additional optional healthcare coverage available at low premiums (Critical Illness, Accident, and Hospital)

title: SOC Analyst
description:
Position Objective
The SOC Analyst will be expected to implement, monitor, and support the security tool platforms that organization and our clients use. This position will primarily support reactionary responses to security related alerts and the setup of clients within the security platforms. This position will require working with the existing Managed Teams in order to ensure proper event/incident identification as well as its legitimacy. Keeping clients, users, and networks secure is the top-most mindset a successful candidate should have.
Responsibilities

• Respond, mitigate, and/or remediate (with high confidence) security-related events or incidents that are sourced from organization’s security platforms

• Work with customers over the phone, or in person to help them understand the received security event/Incident and work towards mitigation and/or remediation

• Onboard clients into the organization security platforms and ensure that full coverage for the organization is achieved and maintained

• Perform vulnerability remediation while obtaining necessary business-related understanding to ensure success of remediation and to determine and communicate any impact to the organization

• Gain competency and mastery on organization's security platforms to act as the backup subject matter-expert (SME) for the organization

• Provide feedback for position and process enhancements to the direct supervisor

• Perform recurring security platform health checks to ensure all monitoring systems and devices are healthy and accurate coverage is observed

• Follow any internal or client-facing change management procedures that may involve this position’s activities

• Participate in organizational (internal) Incident Response table-top exercises

• Review reports and escalate any findings for additional correction

• Attend and participate in professional and technical training opportunities and share key learning points for individual and organizational improvement

• Produce, maintain, and update technical and training documentation

• Perform other duties as required and requested by the Chief Information Security Officer Key Metrics

• Documentation for areas of expertise and daily tasks.

• Adherence to documented SLAs
Qualifications

• Bachelor’s Degree, business related field preferred, or equivalent experience (Preferred)

• At least 3 years with IT Support Experience

• CompTIA Security+ preferred

• Experienced with networking topologies and a firm understanding of intermediate networking concepts

• Must have strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Be detail-oriented
• Able to work well under pressure

• Have excellent communication skills to collaborate with team members and management

title: Graphic Design to UX Design Career Changer
description:
About the Program:
Every year, we sponsor 2 remote UX apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online. Our UX apprentices work through the end-to-end UX design and UX research process for a startup idea of their choice that will help them attract hiring managers in that topic space or industry.
Apprentices take our program for free and receive 1:1 mentorship throughout the 7-month program. Alumni UX apprentices go on to make between $85,000 -$130,000 in UX design, product design, UX research, or service design roles after they complete the program.
We are committed to helping women, immigrants, POC, and LGBTQ folks break into tech and land 6-figure UX jobs. We help you land 6-figure UX jobs or coach you till you get it.
Apprenticeship Requirements:
This apprenticeship program is open to new grads and UX career changers alike! Here are some apprenticeship requirements to keep in mind before applying:
Interested in creative tech career paths in UX research, UX design, product design or service design
Willing to commit 5-10 hours of work per week to complete program deliverables
Willing to attend 2-3 hour weekend lectures to learn the end-to-end design process OR willing to complete online video course modules
Open to feedback from UX mentors and demonstrates a willingness to revise design work
Apprenticeship Program Learnings:
Build digital products and services 0-1
Lead end-to-end design process for a startup idea or topic of your choice
Lead product scoping and feature scoping, as well as entire project management
Identify target market for product and position product for launch success
Develop a business model for the product or service and demonstrate how the product/service will scale as the business model scales
Lead discovery research by managing user recruitment, creating research plans, writing interview guides, leading 8-16 discovery interviews, and synthesizing interview insights
Deliver a compelling UX design and business pitch for your startup idea, showcasing both qualitative and quantitative data to justify the problem space and the solution
Tell a compelling story about users by showcasing user types, personas, stakeholder maps, journey maps, process maps, service blueprints, ideation matrixes, sketches, wireframes, UX workflows, prototypes and other visual deliverables
Lead user testing of wireframes and prototypes to improve product/service usability and constantly iterate on your startup idea
Design a unique design system for your solution from scratch, creating components, a style guide, and branding for your solution
Analyze direct and indirect competitors to clearly articulate your solution’s differentiators and why your solution is innovative and more likely to succeed over competing options
Consult with startups to create a scope of work and fulfill UX research, UX design, product design and service design work based on your scope of work.
How to Apply:
The application takes a few minutes to complete and will ask you to send in your resume. You do NOT need to have a UX resume or portfolio to apply - we consider folks who are at the very beginning of their career change, who are still exploring multiple career options.

You will receive UX tips and challenges via email to help you with your transition into UX and will be contacted by us if you are being considered for the apprentice program. Once contacted, you will go through a brief interview process before joining the cohort. Due to the large volume of applicants, we cannot contact all applicants about their application status. If you don’t hear from us about an interview within 2 months of applying, please consider your application closed. We consider applicants on a rolling basis.

description:

At Redwood, we empower our customers with lights-out automation for their mission-critical business processes.

 

ABOUT US
Redwood Software is the leading orchestration platform for the autonomous enterprise, driving business transformation at the lowest total cost of ownership. Redwood empowers organizations to intelligently automate and orchestrate mission-critical business and IT processes across complex ERP, hybrid cloud, data and emerging agentic AI systems. Through its SaaS-first automation fabric-with AI embedded across the automation lifecycle-Redwood accelerates the path to autonomous operations. Backed by 30 years of experience and trusted by more than 50% of the Fortune 50, Redwood helps organizations unlock human potential to focus on innovation, growth and what’s next.

 

CORE VALUES
One Team. One Redwood
Make Your Own Weather
Obsess over Customer Success
Work the Problem

As a Software Engineer - Principal, IBM z/OS Connectivity, you will help build a new connectivity agent that extends Redwood RunMyJobs (RMJ) natively onto IBM z/OS, enabling Redwood to support some of the largest enterprise automation environments in the market. You will work on systems-level engineering spanning custom wire protocols, cryptography, and a native platform bridge into JES, RACF/SAF, SMF, TSO, and z/OS UNIX System Services (USS), delivered as a Java agent that integrates with the Redwood platform through clean, versioned extension points. This position is open across levels from Software Engineer to Principal as we build out the team.

• Build integrations with core mainframe technologies, including C/JNI, JES2/JES3 job submission and monitoring, TSO command execution via background TMP, and SMF-based event monitoring.

• Integrate security and per-user authorization while extending Redwood’s existing identity and credential management capabilities.

• Develop and maintain systems-level capabilities involving custom wire protocols, cryptography, and native z/OS platform integration.

• Troubleshoot complex system-level issues across mainframe, Unix, and Java environments.

• Improve the reliability, performance, security, and scalability of Redwood’s mainframe solutions.

• Partner with product managers, architects, and engineers to translate customer requirements into effective technical solutions.

• Participate in architecture discussions, design reviews, code reviews, testing, and release planning.

• Leverage agentic AI to accelerate codec, testing, and documentation work while independently verifying correctness against authoritative IBM z/OS references.

• Document protocols, security models, and platform prerequisites for field and support teams.

• Validate technical assumptions on live LPARs and contribute to architectural decisions where modern documentation may be limited.

• Contribute to team success through clear communication, shared responsibility for quality, and accountable ownership of goals and delivery commitments in a fast-paced, iterative agile environment.

 

YOUR EXPERIENCE

• 10+ years of professional software engineering experience with strong Java 8+ skills; IBM Semeru or z/OS Java experience is a plus.

• Hands-on z/OS systems integration experience, including JES2/JES3, TSO, RACF/ACF2/Top Secret, SMF, and USS.

• Strong working proficiency in C.

• Low-level network protocol experience, including socket programming, custom binary framing, character-encoding conversion, and TLS/keyring security.

Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

Developers build trust in a company through the people they meet and the experiences they have with it. We’re looking for someone to shape those experiences for 1Password.

You’ll lead our developer events and in-person community strategy: choosing where we show up, creating gatherings worth returning to, and building relationships that continue after everyone leaves the room. You’ll own the strategy and the details, from deciding whether a conference is worth the investment to welcoming developers at an event you helped produce.

You’ll start with San Francisco and New York City and help expand the program to other cities over time.

How we’re using AI today

Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers.

This is a remote opportunity within the US, with a preference for candidates located in the San Francisco Bay Area or New York City.

What you can expect:

- Shape our events strategy. Build a thoughtful calendar of conferences, meetups, and 1Password-hosted events. Recommend where we should sponsor, speak, participate, or host our own gathering.

- Own conference and sponsorship decisions. Evaluate opportunities, manage organizer relationships and budgets, partner with our events team on execution, and use results to guide future investment.

- Create developer events people want to attend. Plan and run meetups, workshops, dinners, and other gatherings. Own the experience from format and speakers through venue, invitations, and on-site execution.

description:
Copywriter (Women’s Health)
Eyeball Grabber Wanted: You’ve written ads that interrupted the scroll. Emails that earned the click. Landing pages that made the offer feel obvious. Video scripts that hooked fast and held attention. And sales copy that turned complicated product benefits into simple, human, persuasive messages. We want a Copywriter to help us write high-performing, conversion-focused copy across ads, emails, sales pages, social, video scripts, blogs, and more.
Small print here ⇒ We’re a women’s health supplement company. So if you can’t write in a way that makes women feel heard, understood, and safe enough to trust you… this isn’t the role for you.
Still here? Okay then…
This job will give you ALL the feels:
We create clinically supported, natural solutions for some of the biggest health challenges women over 40 face today. And your words will help more women discover those solutions.
Your copy will help a menopausal woman understand her body better. Feel more confident in her choices. Take action. And maybe even change the way she thinks about her health, her future, and what’s possible for her.
If that excites you, you’ll find no better place to continue your copywriting career than here.
This job might be for you if you’ve got…
3-5 years of proven copywriting experience. When we look at your portfolio we’ll see a full-spectrum of ads, emails, landing pages, and sales pages that converted like a Kentucky Tent Revival. There’s no doubt about it… your copy SELLS!
Direct response chops that make your words cut through the clutter. You know how to write hooks, leads, headlines, subject lines, bullets, offers, calls-to-action, and sales arguments that pull people in and keep them reading. If you can make a reader think, “Okay, I need to know where this is going,” we want to talk.
A Makepeace-like ability to turn product features into customer benefits. You don’t stop at “contains calcium, magnesium, boron, and vitamin D3.” You ask: Why does that matter? What does the customer already believe? What are they afraid of? What have they tried? What do they need to understand before this feels worth buying?
A brain that can find the story in the science. You dig through a database of clinical studies, spot the strongest marketing nuggets, and turn them into a compelling product story. You don’t just summarize research. You connect the ingredients, doses, mechanisms, and results in a way that is clear, accurate, persuasive, and easy for a real human to understand. Bonus points if you’ve done this in health, wellness, supplements, or women’s health.
A performance-driven approach to writing. You don’t treat copy like precious art carved into marble. You want to know what worked, what didn’t, and what to test next. CTR, CVR, CPA, open rate, click rate, rankings, traffic, revenue - these numbers don’t bruise your ego. They sharpen your instincts.
A full-funnel writing brain. You understand that a Meta ad, an email, a sales page, a video script, an organic post, and a blog all have different jobs. You can shift tone, format, pace, and depth depending on the channel, while keeping the message consistent and on-brand.
A strong understanding of hooks, angles, and offers. You know the difference between a headline that states a fact and a hook that creates momentum. You can find fresh angles in customer reviews, testimonials, research papers, competitor funnels, product details, and the quiet little objections most writers miss.
The ability to write both short and long. You can write a 12-word ad hook, a 90-character description, a PWAT-style email, a 6,000-word sales page, or a VSL-style script without losing the thread. You know when to be punchy, when to explain,

title: Game Economy Designer [RnD]
description:
Vira Games - незалежна ігрова компанія, що спеціалізується на розробці та видавництві мобільних ігор. Наша команда - це творчий альянс, що об’єднує досвід, креативність, драйвовість та професіоналізм.

Ми шукаємо системного економіста, який візьме на себе управління балансом нашої F2P-гри. Ваше головне завдання - зробити так, щоб гра була захопливою для гравців і водночас прибутковою для бізнесу. Основні обовʼязки:

• Баланс економіки: Налаштування отримання та витрат усіх видів ресурсів. Контроль цінності ігрових валют від Tutorial до Late Game.

• Дизайн прогресії: розрахунок досвіду, налаштування темпу гри та тривалості ігрових сесій. Контроль лімітів і створення мотивації регулярно повертатися до гри.

• Монетизація: Налаштування єдиної економіки. Балансування цін для гібридної моделі IAP + Ads.

• Технічний геймдизайн: написання Production-ready GDD для розробників із зазначенням лімітів, форматів даних та вимог до аналітики.

• Аудит: ведення єдиної бази знань з економіки проєкту.

• Пошук і усунення вразливостей у логіці та балансі гри.

• Побудова та підтримка живих економічних моделей: формули прогресії, криві складності, симуляції.

• Баланс ШІ.

• Аналіз даних плейтестів і поведінкових метрик, пошук дисбалансу; обґрунтування кожного рішення числами.

• Написання production-ready документації для розробників (ліміти, формати даних, вимоги до аналітики).

• Кооперація з геймдизайном, розробкою та аналітикою; реалізація в межах віжену геймдизайнера; пропозиції щодо покращень.

Вимоги:

• Досвідвід 3 років роботи економістом у мобільних F2P-іграх, досвід налаштування Core- та Meta-циклів.

• Обов'язковий досвід роботи з іграми на етапі оперування (LiveOps).

• Поглиблене володіння Excel або Google Sheets (складні формули, зведені таблиці, масиви, індекси).

• Вміння будувати математичні моделі, які легко читати, підтримувати та змінювати.

• Розуміння теорії ймовірностей (Gacha, шанси випадіння предметів), комбінаторики та принципів розрахунку кривих прогресії.

• Розуміння метрик утримання (Retention, Session Length) і монетизації (LTV, ARPDAU, Conversion Rate), а також того, як баланс впливає на поведінку гравця.

• Знання SQL для самостійного отримання та аналізу даних.

Додаткові вимоги:

• AI-Native Workflow: AI для вас - не просто чати та промпти, а інструмент, що багаторазово прискорює роботу. Ви готові до стандартів індустрії, вільно використовуєте нейромережі для симуляції тисяч ігрових сесій, генерації Python-коду для розрахунків балансу та як повноцінного ко-пілота під час написання ТЗ.

• Просунуті навичкиPython (Pandas/NumPy) для складних розрахунків. Досвід візуального моделювання систем. Просунуте володіння SQL для складної аналітики.

• Навичка прорахувати, чи матиме гравець надлишок або нестачу ігрової валюти через пів року гри (LTV 180+), ще на етапі задуму нової фічі.

Передбачувані етапи інтервʼю:

• Інтервʼю з рекрутером

• Тестове завдання (опціонально)

• Інтервʼю з наймаючим менеджером

• Збір рекомендацій

• Офер

Ми пропонуємо:
Бенефіт-кафе: Свобода вибору - персональний бюджет на страхування, навчання, спортзал чи будь-що для твого балансу.
Бонуси за досягнення: Цінуємо strive for excellence і командну гру, відзначаємо помітні результати, ініціативу та реальний вплив.
Remote First: Працюй з будь-якої точки світу віддалена робота є стандартом, а не винятком.
Вплив на бізнес: Мінімум бюрократії, максимум свободи дій і можливість втілювати свої ідеї.
Career Boost: Розвиток професійної експертизи, навчання, внутрішні тренінги, стратегічні сесії.
Culture Driver: Атмосфера єдиної команди, де успіх - результат спільної праці.

Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

Portworx by Everpure is the leading global solution for unlocking the potential of Kubernetes by unlocking the power of data at enterprise scale.  Portworx is a cloud native platform that enterprises depend on to reduce the cost and complexity of rapidly deploying containerized applications across multiple clouds and on-prem environments.  By providing a single standard that works across the environment, we reduce the operating cost of kubernetes, unlock more use cases, respond and pivot to changes due to economic, regulatory and/or business impacts and make it easier to modernize applications, delight developers, and deliver innovation.

Via Portworx, you can manage any database or stateful service on any infrastructure using any container scheduler. You get a single data management layer for all of your stateful services, no matter where they run. And we thrive in multi-cloud environments.

We are looking for Kubernetes experts to help our team capture this massive and rapidly growing market opportunity.  This architect role will serve as the vanguard of the “Kubernetes Everywhere” movement. There’s no safe harbor here for those that can’t, don't, or won’t. There’s also no room for those that put “I” ahead of “We”.

We are customer first, we lead with integrity, and recognize that unlocking achievement requires engagement across the full spectrum of co-selling partners. We are builders, creators, and helping define the next generation of the world’s best modern data platform at Pure.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

The Portworx  Cloud Native Architect is a customer-facing role responsible for providing deep technical and business expertise to customers who want to run stateful applications in containers and automate “Day 2” data management workflows. 

WHAT YOU BRING:

• 5+ years' experience as a customer facing senior-level technical architect.

• Charismatic, confident, and likable self-starter with a track record of success on stage, in the spotlight, and with customers.

• Team oriented leader that is able to coach and drive desired behavior through influence rather than title.

• 5+ years of Linux Administration and/or Linux development experience with an industry recognized administration-level or higher certification.

• 3+ years of Kubernetes Administration experience and a KCNA (Kubernetes and Cloud Native Associate) or above certification.

• Certification-level fluency in OpenShift, Rancher, or other Kubernetes orchestration environment.

• Certification-level fluency in Cloud IaaS environments such as VMware, AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform and OpenStack.

• Certification-level fluency with DevOps concepts and hands-on experience with associated tools, such as; Ansible, Terraform, Docker, and CI/CD pipeline applications.

• Certification-level fluency in data engineering, big data, and database operations, delivery and operational services.

• Demonstrable understanding of data platform technologies as they relate to highly available business applications on-prem, hybrid, and in the cloud

• Demonstrable understanding of the enterprise application development lifecycle and container platforms’ effect on it.

• Demonstrable ability to see and present ‘the big picture’ e.g. thought leadership, offer solutions to improve upon it, and challenge the status quo when it is not in alignment with or in the best interest of desired customer outcomes.

title: AI Video Annotator
description:
About the Role
We are looking for detail-oriented annotators to help label robot manipulation videos for AI training purposes. You'll watch short videos of robots performing manipulation tasks (filmed from three synchronized camera angles) and produce precise, structured, natural-language descriptions of the actions taking place. This work directly supports the development of robotics AI models and requires strong written English, sharp observational skills, and the discipline to follow a detailed style guide consistently.
Project Details

•
Job Title: Project Cursa - Robot Manipulation Video Annotator

•
Location: Remote in India/Philippines﻿/Egypt/Mexico

•
Work type: Freelance

•
Language: English

•
Pay Rate: US$3.5 per hour

What You'll Do

• Watch short robot manipulation videos, each filmed from three synchronized camera views (an overhead view and views from each of the robot's two wrist-mounted cameras).

• Break each video into time segments and write clear, natural-language descriptions for each segment.

• Apply labels at three levels of detail for each applicable segment:

•
Atomic motion (a few seconds) - a single small movement (e.g., "close fingers around the red handle")

•
Skill / subtask (several seconds to ~20 seconds) - a complete, meaningful action (e.g., "pick up the red block by its edge")

•
Task / goal (up to ~1 minute) - the overall purpose of a sequence of skills (e.g., "place all blocks in the container")

• Ensure every moment of video is covered by a label at two or more of these levels - no gaps, including idle or pause moments.

• Accurately describe exactly what happens, including when something doesn't go as planned (a dropped object, a failed grasp, a slipped grip). Precision matters more than making the robot look successful.

• Cross-reference all three camera angles: use the overhead view to understand the overall scene and object identity, and the close-up wrist views to confirm exact contact and grasp details.

• Follow a detailed style guide covering vocabulary for actions, spatial relationships, object descriptions, and manner of movement, applying it consistently across many episodes.

• Participate in periodic calibration sessions to align your labeling with the team and the client's reference examples.
What We're Looking For
Required:

• Strong written English - you'll write dozens of short, precise descriptive sentences per video and need to vary your language rather than repeating the same phrases.

• Sharp attention to detail - able to distinguish small differences (a successful grasp vs. a fumble, a push vs. a drag, which specific object part is being touched).

• Comfort following a detailed, structured style guide and applying it consistently, even in ambiguous or edge-case scenarios.

• Basic comfort with spatial/mechanical description (left/right, above/below, naming object parts like handles, lids, or edges).

• Reliable, self-directed work habits - this is often heads-down work with periodic check-ins rather than close supervision.
Nice to Have:

• Prior experience with video annotation, data labeling, transcription, or QA work.

• Familiarity with robotics terminology (grippers, end-effectors, manipulation) - helpful but not necessary, as the style guide is self-contained.

• Experience with annotation tools such as Label Studio.

title: Technical project manager - Network infrastructure - APAC
description:
About Nebius :

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The Role
We're looking for a Lead Technical Project Manager for Network Infrastructure. This is not a "make slides, chase tickets, and ask engineers for status" job. It is a role for someone with an engineering skeleton: a person who has built, operated, broken and recovered things, and can earn trust in a room full of SREs, SWEs, network engineers, security and platform teams. We are at the early stage of our APAC expansion, so you will work with a high degree of independence, set up the project management practices for the region from scratch, and stay close to the technical details yourself.
The "T" matters. You don't need to be the deepest expert in every area, but you should be technical enough to understand real trade-offs: why rollback is not optional, why "just automate it" can create a bigger blast radius, why a provisioning flow must survive real-world constraints, why SLOs without ownership are decoration, and why network device CI/CD is very different from deploying a stateless service. You can read a design doc, challenge missing assumptions, notice unclear failure modes, ask sharp questions, and turn a vague but important problem into an executable plan.
The "P" is project delivery with a product mindset, even if the product is internal infrastructure. Your product may be a site bootstrap kit, secrets and robot-user management, an SLO framework, a firmware rollout process, a network observability platform, CI/CD for network devices, or automation that makes day-0 and day-N operations safe. The job is not done when the technical pieces exist. It is done when engineers trust the tool, the NOC actually uses the workflow, alerts are actionable, runbooks are real, and the new way becomes the default way. That means adoption, communication, documentation, feedback loops, and sometimes a bit of internal "marketing": the ability to convince smart technical people that the thing is worth using.
The "M" is management of execution, not people management. You will not be responsible for engineers' careers, performance reviews or promotions. You will be responsible for making important cross-team initiatives land: defining scope, aligning owners, exposing risks, driving decisions, tracking dependencies, creating clarity where things are unclear, and making sure we ship useful outcomes instead of collecting half-finished initiatives.
This is a high-leverage role in a early-stage and fast-scaling network infrastructure organisation. Many important systems are being built now: automation, observability, reliability standards, provisioning flows, operational safety, and cross-site consistency. You won't be maintaining a mature machine from the sidelines. You'll help shape how the machine works.
Your responsibilities will include:

• Own end-to-end delivery of cross-team network infrastructure initiatives in APAC, from a vague problem statement to an executable plan to adoption

• Define scope and success criteria, align owners across SRE, SWE, network, security, platform and data center teams, and drive decisions to closure

• Review designs and technical proposals, challenge missing assumptions, and surface failure modes, dependencies and risks early

• Track dependencies and risks acr

title: VP of Campaigns
description:
Position: VP of Campaigns

Department: Advocacy, Strategic Programs

Reports to: Executive Chief of Staff

Supervises: Director of Organizing

FLSA Status: Exempt, Full-Time

Union Status: Not eligible for the bargaining unit

Location: Remote, near a major airport; See below for more

Salary: $146,000 - $163,000

About Us

Advocates for Trans Equality fights for the legal and political rights of transgender people in America. Leveraging decades of experience on the frontlines of power, we shift government and society towards a future where we are no less than equal. Founded in 2024, Advocates for Trans Equality was formed through an alliance by two national trans advocacy organizations and is of, for, and by the trans community. Advocates for Trans Equality (501c4) and Advocates for Trans Equality Education Fund (501c3) focuses its efforts on political and legal advocacy, public education, and community engagement. The Advocates for Trans Equality team catalyzes progress from the inside out and will settle for nothing less than equality for trans people in America. Advocates for Trans Equality and Advocates for Trans Equality Education Fund are incorporated in Washington, DC with offices in DC and New York and employ approximately 40 dedicated staff who share office space and work across the country.

Position Summary

The Vice President of Campaigns is responsible for developing, managing and executing state and federal ballot measure, public education, and advocacy campaigns in partnership with departments of Policy, Legal, Organizing, and Public Education.

The Vice President of Campaigns creates campaign engagement criteria, conducts campaign assessments, and makes recommendations about A4TE’s priorities and investments. They also coordinate A4TE’s cross-team engagement in campaigns, monitor and keep the full team regularly appraised on developments, and serve as the lead on priority campaigns as needed.

Duties and Responsibilities

Primary Responsibilities

• Develop a thoughtful, strategic, coordinated campaign and ballot strategy on behalf of A4TE to address urgent, emerging ballot measures at the state level that have the potential to significantly impact transgender people in the 2026-2028 electoral cycles and beyond.

• Work with A4TE leadership to execute A4TE’s ballot strategy in a manner to ensure such efforts are compliant with all applicable federal, state, and local laws and to protect the charitable statuses of A4TE and A4TEEF.

• Serve as A4TE’s primary external contact and thought partner to LGBTQ+ movement partner organizations for coordination around advocacy strategy tactics influencing ballot issue work and electoral engagement, among other areas of advocacy.

• Manage, cultivate, and inspire the leadership of the Organizing Director, who oversees A4TE’s organizing team. Support the transition of such organizing from predominantly mobilization techniques to deeper field organizing work in service of state needs, particularly around ballot issues.
